title: Estate sale
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, vintage Christmas in an old house, glowing tree lights and hand-blown glass ornaments, deep red and gold tones with cold blue shadows, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. Hang eleven ornaments. Never the twelfth. 🎄

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: The box was the only thing at the estate sale nobody would touch.
scenes.image: an antique wooden box lined with red velvet on a cluttered table in a dim old dining room

scenes.narration: Holly Brandt found it in a dining room that smelled like cedar and dust. Twelve glass ornaments, nested in velvet. Each one hand-blown. Each one clear as ice.
scenes.image: twelve clear hand-blown glass ornaments nested in red velvet slots, soft window light

scenes.narration: She held one up to the light. Inside the glass was a tiny room. A fireplace. A tree. A sofa no bigger than a grain of rice. Perfect. Frozen.
scenes.image: close-up of a clear glass ornament containing a miniature frozen living room with a tiny fireplace

scenes.narration: The seller was the old woman's nephew. He said twenty dollars. Then he changed his mind. Take it for free. Please. Just take it.
scenes.image: nervous middle-aged man in a cardigan standing in a dim hallway, not meeting anyone's eyes

scenes.narration: He followed her out into the snow. He grabbed her sleeve.
scenes.image: a man reaching for a woman's coat sleeve on snowy porch steps of an old house

scenes.narration: Hang eleven, he said. Every year. Never the twelfth. My aunt did it for sixty years.
scenes.image: close-up of a worried man's face with snowflakes in his hair

scenes.narration: Holly asked what happens if you hang the twelfth. He looked back at the house. Every window dark. Every curtain drawn.
scenes.image: an old Victorian house in falling snow, every window dark, curtains drawn

scenes.narration: He said: she was careful for sixty years. She only had to forget once.
scenes.image: an empty rocking chair beside a bare Christmas tree in a shadowy parlor

scenes.narration: At home, Holly unpacked them by her tree. Eleven held little living rooms. The twelfth was empty. Just clear glass. Like it was waiting to be filled.
scenes.image: woman kneeling beside a Christmas tree holding an empty clear glass ornament to the light

scenes.narration: She turned off the lamp. And in the dark, the twelfth ornament began to glow.
scenes.image: a single glass ornament glowing softly inside a velvet box in a dark living room
